mainText: Hello, Verona! At 9 PM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 59 degrees and raining near Verona City Hall. The ISS will pass overhead tonight, but you will not be able to see it due to the clouds. We are under a Third Quarter moon, and tonight's low will be 59 degrees with rain predicted.

Verona has a new EMS Deputy Chief, Liz Gay, who officially began her duties on November 2. She has an extensive background in emergency services and public safety leadership. Also, a reminder that Pellitteri Waste Systems handles our refuse and recycling, so be sure to check their website for collection schedules and proper cart placement instructions.

Today, you can check out Yoga at Insight Wellness. Tomorrow, we have a packed schedule including trivia at Hop Haus, Lake Lou-ee, and Paddy Mac's, plus live music at Paddy Mac's. Looking ahead, you can enjoy trivia at The Bogey Factory on November 5 and live music at Bailey's Run on November 6.

In a noteworthy call from October 25, officers located a 40-year-old man who had been stopped at the intersection of Plympton Street and Rita Avenue for 20 minutes. He was subsequently arrested for an O W I, first offence.

Today's featured flavor at Culver's is the delicious Peanut Butter Fudge Brownie. The store is currently open but will be closing soon in less than an hour, so be sure to stop by before they shut their doors for the night.
